notes: Profile: Series A fintech — payments orchestration for SMB merchants. Moving from rule-based to LLM for merchant support and transaction classification.

Workload detail: primary is chat-based support assistant embedded in merchant dashboard. Secondary: embeddings for knowledge search (help docs, dispute history). Tertiary: reranking model on fraud signal pipeline (fast rescoring of flagged txns).

Targets & constraints: P95 latency target ~150-200ms for short chat responses (<= 256 tokens). Peak concurrent chats ~40-60. Throughput for embedding index builds low (daily batch). Cost sensitive — running initial POC on hosted, want per-route cost visibility.

Model preference: open-models preferred (Llama2/Mistral family) if latency/cost good. Interested in quantized variants; want ability to route non-sensitive or low-risk prompts to cheaper smaller models. Ask: can Redwood do auto-fallback to a smaller variant?

Security/compliance: Require SOC2 Type II evidence before production. SSO via Okta (SAML) mandatory for admin console. Need audit logs + retention controls (90 days default, ask for longer). Data residency: US only for now. Key management: KMS integration desired but can defer to hosted KMS for POC.

POC ask: 4-week POC — test chat flows with ~5 merchants, sample embedding index for support docs, and a small reranking experiment. Success metrics: reduce avg handle time by 20%, embedding search precision > 0.8, reranking latency < 50ms added.
Commercial: SMB price sensitivity. Estimated ARR ask (~$12k-$36k) — likely annualize if POC successful. Open to reserved capacity later if cost/latency justify.
Quote from CTO Anya: 'We want something that just works on day one — hosted is fine for now but we'll push for VPC when we hit >100k txns/mo.'
